With-skill runs passed all 19 expectations; without-skill runs passed 15 of 19.
The largest qualitative difference was image handling: the baseline planned to keep temporary HTTPS URLs in the final page, while the skill correctly converts them to Notion file-upload blocks.
Generic safety assertions passed in both configurations, so the discriminating assertions focus on deterministic helper use, staged-copy integrity, and cleanup.
Timing and true token counts were unavailable from collaboration notifications; the token column is a proxy based on output characters and timing is omitted as zero.
